'''Bas Van Zuilen''' (also written '''Bas Van Zulien''') was the tournament director of the [[2000 Ryloth Regionals]], held in Kaatsheuvel, Netherlands, on 6 August 2000.<ref name="rl00ryloth">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ryloth 2000 Regionals: Ryloth], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140605/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ryloth Internet Archive]</ref> He was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 62 in the Ryloth region, from Wassenaar and later Zoetermeer, Netherlands.<ref name="smlist" /><ref name="decsq-ryloth">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/ryloth.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Ryloth], decipher.com (listings August 1999 – January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115113400/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/regions/ryloth.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He became a Squadron Member in January 1998. With Rogue 6, [[Gepko Sterringa]], he built and ran ryloth.com, a website for the Ryloth region's players.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/vanzuilenbas.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 62 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101104549/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/vanzuilenbas.html Internet Archive]</ref>
